# dremio_ownership (Resource)

Durable ownership in the experimental OSS RBAC fork. Requires active ADMIN and policy OCC. Existing ownership must be imported (including newly created roles and VDS). Owner changes transfer in place. Destroy is intentionally refused for live targets: transfer or explicitly forget state to stop managing; cleanup only succeeds after the namespace ID is proven deleted and never removes grants. Use lifecycle prevent_destroy for live ownership. SYSTEM and bootstrap are unsupported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Import durable ownership first if it already exists (including roles and VDS).
resource "dremio_ownership" "analytics" {
  object_type = "SPACE"
  object_id   = "stable-space-id"
  owner_type  = "ROLE"
  owner_id    = "stable-analyst-role-id"

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# Changing owner_type/owner_id transfers ownership in place.
# To stop managing a live target, explicitly forget state without destroying it.
# Cleanup destroy is only permitted after the namespace target ID is deleted.
# This does not delete the object or revoke any grants.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_id` (String) Stable target ID; never a name.
- `object_type` (String) ROLE, SOURCE, SPACE, FOLDER, PDS, VDS, FUNCTION, VERSIONED_PDS or VERSIONED_VDS.
- `owner_id` (String) Active user UID or existing role ID; changing it transfers ownership in place.
- `owner_type` (String) USER or ROLE; changing it transfers ownership in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical base64url without padding of compact JSON [object_type, object_id].
- `tag` (String) Observed global policy OCC version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Canonical base64url without padding of compact JSON ["SPACE","stable-space-id"].
tofu import dremio_ownership.analytics WyJTUEFDRSIsInN0YWJsZS1zcGFjZS1pZCJd
```
